text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh… My shoulders have been aching lately… I guess that rumor really is true.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um… They say there's, uh… a ghost that shows up at the track at night.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: B-but I'm not scared, obviously! I don't believe in ghosts!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still… I have been doing some solo training at night, and I've been feeling out of it… S-so it's been on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like it really did get to her. She seems a bit under the weather…
